transcript: What would happen if you chewed one clove of garlic every single day? Hey, my friend, garlic is not just food, it is ancient medicine in disguise. Inside this small white bulb lives a warrior called Alesin. When you chew it, not crush, not cook, but chew, you wake up its full power. The moment it touches your tongue, it begins to chase out poisons hiding in your liver. It clears bad spirits, the viruses, the bacteria, even the fungi that live quietly in your body. Your blood flows stronger, your pressure drops like calm water after a storm. Your breath, your lungs, your sinuses, all begin to open. Even the fog in your mind starts to lift. If raw garlic too strong for you, try it with honey, lemon or olive oil. Fermented garlic, pickled garlic, these are gentler but still carry the same ancient force. Remember, one clove a day keeps the inner fire clean. Do it not for one week, but for life. Then you will feel what true energy feels like. If you wish to learn the ancient ways I studied for over 40 years, the herbs, the roots, the teas that restore balance and strength, you can find my book in the bio. It holds the same wisdom I once received from my teachers. Now it is yours to keep.
